title: Larry Hancock: UAP at nuclear facilities 1949-1953, then stopped

tellings.quote: And what they found was high levels of activity from 1949 until 1953, and then it just stopped.

plain: Unexplained objects showed high levels of activity around US nuclear facilities from 1949 until 1953, and then it just stopped, according to an article by a researcher named Larry Hancock for SCU, a group of researchers who study UAP, the government's term for UFOs. A researcher named Steven Bruel relays Hancock's finding to Michels, offering the sudden stop as a pattern worth explaining.
